name: Sample – EasyTrade trading platform
description: EasyTrade end to end: digital experience, gateway, trading APIs, core services, data tier and host, with golden signals on every hop. Components select EasyTrade's entities by name. Saved with a fixed window in which the demo had traffic — pick a recent timeframe for live data.

data.name: EasyTrade Web
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "FRONTEND"
| filter name == "EasyTrade"
| fields id, id_classic, name

items.dql:
fetch user.events
| filter frontend.name == "EasyTrade"
| summarize sessions = countDistinct(dt.rum.session.id)

fetch user.events
| filter frontend.name == "EasyTrade"
| filter characteristics.classifier == "user_action"
| summarize actions = count()

fetch user.events
| filter frontend.name == "EasyTrade"
| filter characteristics.classifier == "error"
| summarize errors = count()

data.name: Partner aggregators
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "PROCESS"
| filter name == "aggregator-service"
| fields id, name

data.name: Edge gateway (nginx)
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == ":80" or name == "nginx"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries { failures = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar: true), requests = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar: true) },
  filter: { dt.service.name == ":80" or dt.service.name == "nginx" }
| fieldsAdd rate = 100.0 * failures / requests
| fields rate

data.name: Login
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "easyTradeLoginService" or name == "easyTradeLoginService.dll"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService" or dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService.dll" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

timeseries { failures = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar: true), requests = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar: true) },
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService" or dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService.dll" }
| fieldsAdd rate = 100.0 * failures / requests
| fields rate

data.name: Broker (trading API)
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "BrokerService" or name == "BrokerService.dll"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "BrokerService" or dt.service.name == "BrokerService.dll" }

timeseries { failures = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count, scalar: true), requests = sum(dt.service.request.count, scalar: true) },
  filter: { dt.service.name == "BrokerService" or dt.service.name == "BrokerService.dll" }
| fieldsAdd rate = 100.0 * failures / requests
| fields rate

data.name: Offers
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "easytrade_offer_service"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easytrade_offer_service" }

data.name: Accounts
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "AccountControllerV2" or name == "SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.accountservice.AccountServiceApplic"
| fields id, name

data.name: Credit card orders
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "ManufacturerController" or name == "OrderController" or name == "Requests executed in background threads of SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.creditcardorderservice.Application" or name == "Requests executed in background threads of SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.thirdpartyservice.Application" or name == "SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.creditcardorderservice.Application"
| fields id, name

data.name: Feature flags
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "FlagController" or name == "SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.featureflagservice.Featureflagservi"
| fields id, name

data.name: Trading engine
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "Requests executed in background threads of SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.engine.EngineApplication" or name == "SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.engine.EngineApplication" or name == "Tomcat/localhost (/api)"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "Requests executed in background threads of SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.engine.EngineApplication" or dt.service.name == "SpringBoot com.dynatrace.easytrade.engine.EngineApplication" or dt.service.name == "Tomcat/localhost (/api)" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

data.name: Pricing
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == ":8080" or name == "pricing-service"
| fields id, name

data.name: Market analysis
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "PriceAnalysisComputation"
| fields id, name

data.name: Core ledger (Manager)
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "easyTradeManager" or name == "easyTradeManager.dll"
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easyTradeManager" or dt.service.name == "easyTradeManager.dll" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

entities.dql:
smartscapeNodes "PROCESS", from: now()-7d
| filter name == "MSSQL" or name == "RabbitMQ"
| fields id, name
| sort name asc

items.dql:
fetch logs
| filter loglevel == "ERROR" or loglevel == "CRITICAL"
| summarize errors = count()

data.name: EasyTrade host
data.entityDql:
smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| filter name == "BrokerService"
| traverse edgeTypes: {runs_on}, targetTypes: {HOST}
| fields id, name

items.dql:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage, scalar: true)
| fields cpu

timeseries memory = avg(dt.host.memory.usage, scalar: true)
| fields memory

kpi.dql:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService" or dt.service.name == "easyTradeLoginService.dll" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "BrokerService" or dt.service.name == "BrokerService.dll" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == ":8080" or dt.service.name == "pricing-service" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
| fields ms

timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time, scalar: true),
  filter: { dt.service.name == "easyTradeManager" or dt.service.name == "easyTradeManager.dll" }
| fieldsAdd ms = rt / 1000
